name: access-review
description: Visual review of Microsoft Access front ends without touching the desktop, plus COM automation of Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Visio and other Office apps with safety guards.
long_description:
Access Review lets Claude review the forms of a Microsoft Access front end while you keep using the same PC. It starts its own Access instance over COM, keeps every Access window just past the edge of the desktop, and captures forms with PrintWindow, so nothing comes to the front, nothing takes focus and no mouse or keyboard input is sent.

Tools open a front end, open and size forms to their designed dimensions, capture PNGs (whole form or a zoomed crop), list control positions and colours for spacing checks, catch and close VBA and Office message boxes, compile, run public VBA procedures, read the app's error log, snapshot form definitions and compare two builds property by property, export form designs as JSON for rebuilding them elsewhere, and switch colour palettes in apps that have a palette procedure.

OneNote tools read, compare and capture pages of local OneNote notebooks through the OneNote desktop app (for apps that publish pages, such as a leadership binder): page summaries with record IDs, outline positions, styles and colours, before-and-after snapshots, record-ID checks and off-screen page captures. Cloud and work notebooks are never read.

Office tools drive Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project and Publisher (and Outlook when you enable it) through their COM object models: start an app in its own off-screen instance, open, create, save and export documents to PDF, capture windows, read and write cells, read a document's paragraphs, list slides, shapes and tags, list mail items, run a trusted document's macros, and reach any other method or property with a generic member-path tool plus a type-library browser. Guards: only enabled apps, files only from your folders and never from the internet, macros off unless asked, members that run supplied code, start programs, send mail or keys, print or quit are refused, Outlook items are read only, paths and web addresses in arguments are checked, and every call is written to an audit log.

Windows only. Needs desktop Microsoft Access (tested with Microsoft 365) and Windows PowerShell 5.1, which comes with Windows. Open only front ends you trust: under automation Access runs their startup code without the Enable Content bar, so the extension opens files only from the folder you choose and refuses files downloaded from the internet.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an existing front end in a separate, off-screen Access instance.

tools.name: close_app
tools.description: Reset the palette, quit Access without saving design changes and confirm it has gone.

tools.name: open_form
tools.description: Open a form at its designed size or a given size.

tools.name: resize_form
tools.description: Resize an open form: design size, a given size or maximized.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: PNG of an open form, or a zoomed crop of it.

tools.name: controls
tools.description: Position, size, caption and colours of every control on a form.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Save forms' definitions (SaveAsText) as a labelled snapshot.

tools.name: compare_snapshots
tools.description: Compare two snapshots property by property: added, removed and changed controls.

tools.name: export_design
tools.description: Write a snapshot's forms as JSON designs for rebuilding them in another app or as HTML.

tools.name: dialogs
tools.description: List, capture and close message boxes and popups.

tools.name: error_log
tools.description: Mark the app's error log, then list entries added since.

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile and save all VBA modules.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a public VBA procedure or function.

tools.name: set_palette
tools.description: Switch the app's colour palette and reopen the open forms.

tools.name: review_lock
tools.description: Take shared reviewer lock files on a machine several reviewers use.

tools.name: review_unlock
tools.description: Release the lock files this reviewer took.

tools.name: onenote_notebooks
tools.description: List the local OneNote notebooks this tool may use (never cloud or work notebooks).

tools.name: onenote_open_notebook
tools.description: Open an existing local OneNote notebook in the OneNote desktop app.

tools.name: onenote_pages
tools.description: Sections and pages of local notebooks, with each page's record ID.

tools.name: onenote_page
tools.description: Read a page as title, record IDs, outlines with position and size, and lines with styles and colours.

tools.name: onenote_capture
tools.description: PNG of a page drawn in a new off-screen OneNote window.

tools.name: onenote_snapshot
tools.description: Save every page's XML of a notebook or section as a labelled snapshot.

tools.name: onenote_compare
tools.description: Compare two OneNote snapshots: pages, record IDs, outlines and text lines changed.

tools.name: onenote_check_ids
tools.description: Check page record IDs: missing, duplicated, expected but not found.

tools.name: office_apps
tools.description: Which Office apps are installed, enabled and started.

tools.name: office_start
tools.description: Start an Office app in its own off-screen (or hidden) instance.

tools.name: office_quit
tools.description: Close this tool's documents and quit the app it started.

tools.name: office_open
tools.description: Open an existing Excel, Word, PowerPoint or Visio file from an allowed folder.

tools.name: office_new
tools.description: Make a new blank workbook, document, presentation or drawing.

tools.name: office_close
tools.description: Close a document without saving.

tools.name: office_save_as
tools.description: Save a document under a full path in an allowed folder.

tools.name: office_export_pdf
tools.description: Write a PDF of a document.

tools.name: office_capture
tools.description: PNG of an Office app or document window, drawn off screen.

tools.name: office_invoke
tools.description: Get, set or call any member path of an Office object model; objects come back as handles.

tools.name: office_members
tools.description: Methods and properties an object offers, from its type library.

tools.name: office_release
tools.description: Forget object handles.

tools.name: office_run_macro
tools.description: Run a macro in a document opened with macros enabled.

tools.name: excel_range
tools.description: Read or write a block of cells.

tools.name: word_text
tools.description: Paragraphs of a Word document with styles.

tools.name: powerpoint_slides
tools.description: Slides, shapes, text and tags of a presentation.

tools.name: outlook_items
tools.description: Mail items in an Outlook folder (read only).

allowed_folder.title: Front-end folder
allowed_folder.description: The only folder (and its subfolders) open_app and office_open may open files from, and the Office tools may save into (besides the capture folder). Under automation Access runs a file's startup code without the Enable Content bar, so keep only files you trust here.

output_dir.title: Capture folder
output_dir.description: Where captures are saved, one subfolder per session. Leave blank for %LOCALAPPDATA%\AccessReview.

lock_files.title: Shared lock files
lock_files.description: Only when several reviewers share one PC: full paths of lock files, separated by semicolons. Leave blank otherwise.

palettes.title: Palettes
palettes.description: Palettes set_palette offers, as name=number pairs separated by semicolons; the number is passed to the palette procedure and the first is the default. Leave blank for the access-modern-ui palettes (Navy=1;Midnight=2;Teal Navy=6).

palette_procedure.title: Palette procedure
palette_procedure.description: Public VBA Sub in your front end that switches palettes, taking the palette number. Leave blank for SetPalette.

sentry_dsn.title: Sentry DSN
sentry_dsn.description: Optional. Reports new error-log entries and VBA message boxes to this Sentry project: error number, procedure, form and control only, never the error text, dialog text, user or computer names. Leave blank to report nothing.

office_apps.title: Office apps
office_apps.description: Office apps the office_* tools may drive, separated by semicolons. Leave blank for excel;word;powerpoint;visio;project;publisher;access. Add outlook only if Claude may read the mail of this PC's Outlook profile (read only; sending, moving and deleting are always refused).

office_attach.title: Attach to running Office apps
office_attach.description: Leave blank (recommended). PowerPoint, Outlook, Project and Publisher keep one instance per user, so while you have one open office_start refuses rather than take it over. Apps listed here (separated by semicolons) are attached to instead; they are never quit or captured.
